author: Pony Supremacy 🔮
content:
I want to make something clear for you:
- Raiden Standard and Raiden Ultimate have the same level of protections we do not advertise or market our protections for either of these memberships protections (they are the same protection wise)
- Ultimate features are primarily unrestricted access to our recovery tools, and enhanced themes with imGUI.
- Most of the options in the Session tab and Protections don't work because it's simply impossible to block every possible protection from every menu given the variety of methods / GTA constantly updates to patch vulnerabilities with how players connect with eachother ingame
- The more features you enable the weaker your processing power becomes if you have a limited graphics card or processor with only 4 dedicated cores it will eventually run out of resources running the game, operating system and you constantly enabling features (leading up to a crash)
- Most free menus don't offer a commitment to your safety with recovery options (and often times have a high ban risk or may contain malicious or invasive activity)
- Most free menus are open source what does that mean?; it means anyone on the internet can modify or suggest changes to the menus source code in order to improve the menu or add features (given the nature of our product its closed source)
- Our development team is small and has a focus to improve existing features, maintain recovery options (priority), and protect the integrity of our products 
- Raiden offers two seamlessly integrated UIs that are incredibly easy to use a nativeUI (native to the games UI renderer) and imGUI to provide an easy to use mouse UI. If you haven't guessed your experience might vary between each of these menus because our developers have to provide support for both (features might be displayed differently or function differently between these menus)

I absolutely understand your frustration when it comes to purchasing something and having high expectations for all options to work but, this simply isn't the case due to the cost of our product we have priorities and protections isn't one of them our menu isn't intended to troll players, protect you from modders (play in a closed friend session), and compete with free menus. In this competitive market there are no other products like Raiden (Ovix is a yimmenu reskin or reskin of an open source menu) that can offer a budget friendly, affordable, and secure experience for its users at a low cost.

Raiden has these tradeoffs in order to keep our products cheap, affordable, and secure for our userbase. If you'd like to see some improvement on a specific features our developers are financially motivated feel free to make a contribution.

I hope I was able to answer your questions.
(edited)

author: Merryweather Security
content:
Do the following steps to correct this issue. This will turn of Memory Integrity and Core Isolation.
This Will allow KDMapper to inject Raiden into your Memmory.


Open Registry Editor: Press Win + R, type regedit, and press Enter.

Navigate to the following key:

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Security\HealthState

Create a new DWORD value:

Right-click on the HealthState key, select "New" > "DWORD (32-bit) Value."

Name the new value Hardware_HVCI_Off.

Set the value to 0:

Double-click on Hardware_HVCI_Off and set its value to 0.

Restart your computer to apply the changes



Navigate to the following key:

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity

Modify the DWORD value:

In the right pane, you'll see a DWORD value named Enabled.

Double-click on Enabled and set its value to 0



Press Win + R, type regedit, and press Enter.

Navigate to the following key:

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios

Locate the MemoryIntegrity key:

Click on the HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity key.

Modify the DWORD value:

In the right pane, you'll see a DWORD value named Enabled.

author: Merryweather Security
content:
@beto_5108
Run a SFC scan if possible

Note it may take a while and your PC might restart.

To run a System File Checker (SFC) scan on Windows, follow these steps:

1.
Open Command Prompt as Administrator
: Press
Win + R
to open the Run dialog, type
cmd
, right-click on "Command Prompt," and select "Run as administrator.".

2.
Run SFC Command
: Type
sfc /scannow
and press Enter. This will scan your system files for corruption and attempt to repair any issues.

3.
Wait for Completion
: Let the scan run until it completes. This may take some time, so be patient

4.
Review Results
: After the scan is complete, you will see a message indicating whether any corrupted files were found and if they were successfully repaired.

What is a Signed Driver?
A signed driver is a device driver or kernel module that has been cryptographically signed by its developer or producer using a digital signature (Verified by Microsoft). This signature ensures the driver's authenticity and integrity, confirming that it hasn't been tampered with

So its the because of the driver used to inject Raiden into your system memory. This will allow Raiden to be undetected from BattlEye.

(edited)

Now that
Raiden is back online
, we want to introduce what is going on behind the scenes.

## Introducing Raiden Reloaded:
Raiden Reloaded is a kernel driver that allows Raiden to run in Grand Theft Auto V without being detected by BattlEye.

## How it works
The Raiden launcher isn't able to directly run in the kernel of your system, the driver is used as the injector, loading Raiden into the file, and adding it to GTA, then exiting. It is a little picky on how it works, however you're not able to inject with Grand Theft Auto V open. The launcher is a wizard and will guide you, but the process must be started before Grand Theft Auto V is opened. Raiden Reloaded is just an add-on necessary to ensure Raiden continues to function, it's included in all membership tiers. 

## So what changes?
Nothing, your access to Raiden remains unchanged, and we're commiting to keeping it that way. New features will continue to be released to both Raiden tiers in the future. You will also need to re-enable BattlEye to join sessions.

.
Remember to turn off your antivirus before downloading so it doesn't break/block the launcher.
(edited)
Ensure all the required settings are turned off in MS Defender.

RCon Password: Set this in your server configuration file (server.cfg).

```[
{{{CITATION{{{_2{What is recon_password? - FiveM Client Support - Cfx.re Community](
https://forum.cfx.re/t/what-is-recon-password/488593)```
You'll need the IP address and port of your server. For example, if your server IP is 123.456.789.0 and the port is 1234, you would connect to 123.456.789.0:1234.

Open your RCon tool (e.g., Icecon), enter the server IP, port, and RCon password, and you'll be able to execute commands on your server.

For GTA V, the server ports you need to forward on your router are:

TCP: 27015, 27036

UDP: 6672, 27015, 27031-27036, 61455-61458

Open Command Prompt as Administrator:
Press the Windows key + X and select Command Prompt (Admin) or Windows Terminal (Admin).


Click Yes if prompted by User Account Control.


Run the DISM Tool First (optional but recommended):
Type the following command and press Enter:

DISM.exe /Online /Cleanup-image /Restorehealth
Wait for the process to complete (this may take some time).


Run the SFC Scan:
Type the following command and press Enter:

sfc /scannow
Wait for the scan to complete. This can also take some time.


Review the Results:
Once the scan is complete, you'll see a message indicating whether any issues were found and fixed.


Restart Your Computer:
After the scan is complete, restart your computer to apply any changes.
